snippet.title: MARKIPLIER MONTAGE ~ V1 TRAILER.
snippet.description:
“As the lights go out, so do the monsters arrive. Spirits hiding within the dark, shall make their presence known. You were warned.”
MARKIPLIER MONTAGE V1.
COMING IN NOVEMBER.
THEY'LL BE SEEING YOU SOON.
NOT MUCH TIME LEFT NOW.
___________________________________________________________________________
Happy Halloween guys! I hoped you liked this trailer we've made for the upcoming v1 update of Montage. A lot has changed since the demo, and we'll finally be able to do what we made the mod for in the first place. Make Boned playable. I'll be showing more stuff in the lead-up to the release. See you soon!

PS. This Trailer was originally intended for the Ramware Broadcast. However due to complications with the Ramware team and timings not lining up, we had to release the trailer seperately. I wish the Ramware team a lot of luck in completing the Broadcast. There's some truly great mods still on it so i'll hope you guys check it out when it releases.
___________________________________________________________________________
Thumbnail Art by https://x.com/MarstianMars
Video by @LennyFace2 , @Molten_Prod and me.
Animation by @Molten_Prod 
SFX in the intro by https://x.com/Mut4nt87
___________________________________________________________________________
